veg.make_ahead: Make the base up to 2 days ahead and chill; sear the mushrooms on the night and add the zucchini and beans just before serving

steps.text: Slice the fennel and onion, crush the garlic, cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick coins and the zucchini into chunks.
Sear the mushroom coins in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until golden on both sides, then set aside.
Soften the fennel, onion and garlic in the rest of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, white wine, vegetable stock and crumbled nori and simmer.
Add the zucchini and cannellini beans for 8 minutes, then return the mushrooms to warm through.
Serve with sliced sourdough.

veg_af.make_ahead: Simmer the stock base up to 2 days ahead and chill; sear the mushrooms and finish with the zucchini and beans on the night

steps.text: Slice the fennel and onion, crush the garlic, cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick coins and the zucchini into chunks.
Sear the mushroom coins in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until golden on both sides, then set aside.
Soften the fennel, onion and garlic in the rest of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, vegetable stock, extra stock, white wine vinegar and crumbled nori and simmer.
Add the zucchini and cannellini beans for 8 minutes, then return the mushrooms to warm through.
Serve with sliced sourdough.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the orange and lime juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil and toss through the portobello mushrooms.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Roast the mushrooms at 200C for 25 minutes, then slice. Slice the smoked tofu thinly.
Spread the rolls with mustard and layer with the mushrooms, smoked tofu, Swiss cheese and sliced pickles.
Press in a pan with the butter until crisp on both sides.

veg.n: Hideout cabin haloumi with dill butter
veg.make_ahead: Mix the dill butter up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled; seal the haloumi and zucchini parcels up to 4 hours ahead; bake and fry the beans on the night

steps.text: Mash the soft butter with the chopped dill, the zest of a lemon and the crushed garlic clove.
Boil the baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, crush lightly and toss with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and salt.
Halve the zucchini lengthways and lay on squares of foil, top each with a haloumi slab, a slice of the butter and a lemon slice, then seal.
Bake at 200C for 15 minutes.
Fry the green beans in a hot pan with the rest of the oil for 4 minutes until charred.

veg.n: Wade and Vanessa's portobello steak frites
veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead in cold water and crush the garlic; roast the chips and cook the mushrooms and sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in 2 tbsp of the oil and roast at 220C until crisp.
Brush the portobello mushrooms with the rest of the oil and sear in a very hot pan, then add the butter and garlic and baste until tender.
Lift out the mushrooms, add the red wine and mushroom stock to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Slice the mushrooms thickly and serve with the chips and sauce by candlelight.

veg_af.n: Wade and Vanessa's portobello steak frites (alcohol free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead in cold water; roast the chips, sear the mushrooms and reduce the sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in 2 tbsp of the oil and roast at 220C until crisp.
Brush the portobello mushrooms with the rest of the oil and sear in a very hot pan, then add the butter and garlic and baste until tender.
Lift out the mushrooms, add all the mushroom stock and the red wine vinegar to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Slice the mushrooms thickly and serve with the chips and sauce by candlelight.

veg.n: Dinner party cauliflower steaks with chimichurri
veg.make_ahead: Make the chimichurri up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; roast the potatoes and cauliflower steaks on the night

steps.text: Boil the baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes.
Chop the parsley, garlic cloves and red chilli and mix with olive oil, red wine vinegar and dried oregano.
Cut 2 thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower, brush with olive oil, season and roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Char the cauliflower steaks on a very hot barbecue 2 minutes a side, then spoon the chimichurri over.
Serve with the potatoes and the salad leaves dressed with olive oil.

veg.n: Smoky mushroom ribs, corn and potato salad
veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms baked up to 1 day ahead, glaze to serve

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways, score the cut sides, rub with the brown sugar, paprika, garlic and 1 tbsp of the olive oil, then wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until tender.
Boil the potatoes until tender, cool slightly, and toss with the Dijon, the rest of the oil and the vinegar.
Unwrap the mushrooms, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.
Char the corn on a grill.

veg.make_ahead: Brown and simmer the mushroom and bean stew up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat, then mix and steam the dumplings on the night

steps.text: Chop the onion, celery and carrots and quarter the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the chopped vegetables and thyme and soften.
Add the vegetable stock and cannellini beans and simmer.
Rub the butter into the flour and mix with the milk.
Drop spoonfuls on top and steam covered.

veg.make_ahead: Reduce the vinegar up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C.
Reduce the vinegar with tarragon and the chopped shallot to a spoonful.
Whisk with the yolks over simmering water and drizzle in 170g of the butter, melted and warm.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze and simmer in the cream.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and garlic, season and sear in a very hot pan with the rest of the butter, 4 minutes a side.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the crumb with the parsley and lemon zest up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast the eggplant, crumb it and cook the potatoes and beans on the night

steps.text: Cut the eggplants lengthways into thick slabs, brush with the olive oil, salt and roast at 220C for 15 minutes.
Spread the eggplant with Dijon and press on breadcrumbs mixed with chopped parsley and lemon zest.
Roast until the crumbs are golden.
Boil the potatoes, then crush with half the butter and salt.
Steam the green beans and toss with the rest of the butter.

veg.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soften the onion in oil with the ginger, garlic and curry powder.
Add the sweet potato, chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer for 30 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Cook the rice and serve with mango chutney.

veg.n: Eric's castle mushrooms with tarragon cream
veg.make_ahead: Halve and score the mushrooms and chop the shallot up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; cook everything on the night

steps.text: Halve the mushrooms lengthways, score the cut sides, season and chop the shallot.
Sear the mushrooms cut side down in oil, then finish in a 200C oven for 10 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot in some of the butter, add the stock and lemon juice and reduce by half.
Add the cream and tarragon and simmer.
Boil the potatoes and toss in the rest of the butter. Steam the beans.

veg.n: Molly Brown's first class celeriac filet
veg.make_ahead: Simmer the celeriac rounds up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake the potatoes, sear and roast the celeriac and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Layer the potatoes with most of the butter, melted, season and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna.
Peel the celeriac, cut into 4 thick rounds, simmer in salted water for 10 minutes and pat dry.
Sear the rounds in the oil and the rest of the butter, then roast alongside the potatoes for 20 minutes.
Reduce the shallots, wine and mushroom stock to a sauce in the same pan.
Steam the beans and serve everything together.

veg_af.n: Molly Brown's first class celeriac filet (alcohol free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Simmer the celeriac up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake the potatoes, sear the rounds and reduce the sauce on the night

steps.text: Layer the potatoes with most of the butter, melted, season and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna.
Peel the celeriac, cut into 4 thick rounds, simmer in salted water for 10 minutes and pat dry.
Sear the rounds in the oil and the rest of the butter, then roast alongside the potatoes for 20 minutes.
Reduce the shallots, all the mushroom stock and the red wine vinegar to a sauce in the same pan.
Steam the beans and serve everything together.

veg.make_ahead: Gravy up to 2 days, cook patties fresh

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry. Mash the black beans and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, 1 egg, salt and pepper, then shape into 4 patties.
Cook the rice.
Fry the patties in the rest of the oil until crisp and set aside.
Soften the sliced onion in the pan, stir in the flour, stock and soy sauce and simmer.
Fry the remaining 4 eggs. Serve the patties on rice, topped with a fried egg and the gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Caramelise the onions and mix the horseradish mayo up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; bake the fries and sear the mushrooms on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss with oil and bake at 220C, turning halfway.
While the fries bake, slowly cook the sliced onions in butter until caramelised.
Mix the mayonnaise with the horseradish.
Brush the mushrooms with oil, season and sear hard in a hot pan until tender.
Slice the mushrooms thickly.
Toast the rolls and fill with mushrooms, onions, Swiss cheese and horseradish mayo.
Serve with the fries alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Roll the plant-based mince into balls and slice the onion up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; smash and cook fresh

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into 12 balls and slice the onion.
Smash thin on a hot griddle in batches, salt, and flip after 90 seconds, adding cheese.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles and onion and pile onto a platter.

veg.make_ahead: Gravy up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Trim the cauliflower, keeping it whole, and rub with the butter, garlic, thyme and salt.
Toss the potatoes and carrots in the oil and roast with the cauliflower, covered, at 200C for 40 minutes.
Uncover and roast another 40 minutes until the cauliflower is tender and deep golden.
Lift out the cauliflower and vegetables to rest. Fry the onion in the tray juices, whisk in the flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer into gravy. Serve after church.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom and lentil chilli up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled or freeze up to 3 months; reheat and add the toppings on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil in a heavy pot until brown and dry.
Add the diced onion and the garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then the cumin, the chilli powder and the chipotle in adobo.
Stir in the tinned tomatoes, the vegetable stock, the dark chocolate and the lentils and simmer 30 minutes.
Add the drained kidney beans for the last 15 minutes.
Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom paprikash up to 2 days ahead without the sour cream and keep chilled; reheat, stir the sour cream through and cook the noodles fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches, then soften the onions and the red capsicum in the pan.
Stir in the sweet paprika, add the vegetable stock and the mushrooms, and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the egg noodles and toss with the butter.
Stir the sour cream through off the heat and serve over the buttered egg noodles.

veg.make_ahead: Mix and press the nut roast into its tin up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day with the potatoes and cook the sprouts fresh

ingredients.item: mushrooms, finely chopped (300g for the roast, 100g for the sprouts)

steps.text: Fry the onion and 300g of the mushrooms in the butter until dry, then mix with the nuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, eggs, cheddar and thyme and press into a lined loaf tin.
Roast the nut roast, and the parboiled potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil, at 200C for 50 minutes.
Toss the chipolatas with 1 tbsp of the maple syrup and the smoked paprika and add to the oven for the last 20 minutes.
Fry the sprouts in the rest of the oil with the remaining 100g of mushrooms until browned and smoky, then toss with the rest of the maple syrup.
Whisk the flour into the potato tray juices, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer into gravy. Rest the nut roast 10 minutes, slice and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Pilaf can be reheated, serve with fresh almonds

steps.text: Brown the eggplant in the oil. Add the onion, carrots, cumin and cinnamon and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas, rice and stock, cover and cook on low.
Rest the pilaf, covered, for 10 minutes. Toast the almonds meanwhile.
Pile onto a platter with the raisins and almonds. Serve with yoghurt mixed with the garlic.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the onion and capsicum and trim the beans up to 1 day ahead; cook the paella on the night

steps.text: Dice the onion and capsicum, crush the garlic and trim the beans. Heat the stock with the saffron.
Fry the chickpeas and mushrooms in the oil with 1 tsp of the paprika in a wide pan until crisp at the edges.
Add the onion, garlic, capsicum and the rest of the paprika and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice and hot stock, then cook without stirring.
Push the artichoke hearts and beans into the rice for the last 5 minutes, then rest briefly and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil ragu up to 3 days ahead, or freeze up to 2 months; reheat and boil the spaghetti on the night

steps.text: Dice the carrots and celery and finely chop the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Add the carrot and celery and soften.
Add the tomatoes and lentils and simmer.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Toss with the sauce and plenty of vegetarian parmesan-style cheese.

veg.make_ahead: Onions can be cooked 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the onions in a little of the butter over low heat until soft and golden.
Shape the plant-based mince into 4 thin oval patties, season, and sear in a hot pan until browned on both sides.
Butter the bread on the outside. Build each sandwich with a patty, onions and two slices of Swiss cheese.
Griddle the sandwiches in a pan over medium heat, turning once, until crisp and the cheese has melted.

veg.make_ahead: Parboil the potatoes and cut the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast, sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Parboil the potatoes, then shake to rough up.
Roast in 3 tbsp of hot oil at 220C until crisp.
Cut 2 thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower, brush with the rest of the oil, season and roast on a second tray for 25 minutes.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in a very hot pan, basting with butter, until charred.
In the same pan add the peppercorns and brandy, then cream and stock, and simmer until thick.
Spoon the sauce over the steaks.

veg_af.n: Hellfire Club pepper cauliflower steak (alcohol free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Parboil the potatoes and cut the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast, sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Parboil the potatoes, then shake to rough up.
Roast in 3 tbsp of hot oil at 220C until crisp.
Cut 2 thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower, brush with the rest of the oil, season and roast on a second tray for 25 minutes.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in a very hot pan, basting with butter, until charred.
In the same pan add the peppercorns, apple juice and cider vinegar, then cream and stock, and simmer until thick.
Spoon the sauce over the steaks.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Finely chop the mushrooms, onion and garlic and fry in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until all the liquid is gone. Stir in the spinach to wilt, season and cool.
Lay the filling along two overlapping sheets of puff pastry, roll into a log, seal, brush with 1 beaten egg and bake at 200C for 40 minutes.
Roast the potatoes in the rest of the olive oil.
Whisk the remaining 3 eggs, the flour for the batter and the milk and bake in hot tins with the vegetable oil at 220C.
Whisk the gravy flour into the mushroom pan, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer into gravy.
Rest the wellington 10 minutes before slicing.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrap tight

steps.text: Slice the smoked tofu thinly and pat dry.
Split the rolls and layer with the smoked tofu, chargrilled eggplant, provolone, lettuce, tomato and onion.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar and sprinkle with oregano. Wrap tight and cut in half.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips and haloumi fingers up to 4 hours ahead, chips in cold water; make the slaw up to 4 hours ahead and fry everything to order

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and dry well. Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and pat dry.
Shred the cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Fry the chips in the oil twice, once to cook through and once to crisp.
Whisk the flour with cold lager into a batter, dip the haloumi and fry for 2 minutes until golden.
Serve with tartare.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 4 hours ahead in cold water and the haloumi up to 1 day ahead; dress the slaw up to 4 hours ahead and fry to order

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and dry well. Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and pat dry.
Shred the cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Fry the chips in the oil twice, once to cook through and once to crisp.
Whisk the flour with cold soda water into a batter, dip the haloumi and fry for 2 minutes until golden.
Serve with tartare.

veg.n: Creamy mushroom, leek and butter bean casserole
veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom and butter bean filling up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; top with pastry and bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the leeks in the same pan.
Add the white wine, cream and butter beans and simmer until thick.
Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.

veg_af.n: Creamy mushroom, leek and butter bean casserole (alcohol free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Make the mushroom, bean and stock filling up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; top with pastry and bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the leeks in the same pan.
Add the vegetable stock, vinegar, cream and butter beans and simmer until thick.
Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Patties shaped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Shape the plant-based mince into balls ready to smash. Mix the mustard and tomato sauce.
Heat a griddle until smoking. Smash each ball into a thin patty, season and cook for 2 minutes a side, adding cheese at the end.
Toast the buns. Stack two patties per bun with sauce, pickles and onion.
Plate on fine china with silver cutlery and linen napkins.

veg.n: Shepherd's pie she passes off as hers (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble then bake

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and chop the mushrooms. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, add the onion and carrot, then the tomato paste, soy sauce, stock and lentils. Simmer.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Top the lentils with the mash and bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the haloumi into slabs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; chop the vegetables and roast on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and the haloumi into 8 slabs.
Toss the potatoes, carrots and chickpeas with the oil and season.
Roast at 220C for 35 minutes.
Lay the haloumi on top and roast 10 minutes more.
Warm the honey with the garlic and thyme, brush over the haloumi and roast until glossy.
Pile onto a board to share.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sauce up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently; dress the slaw and fry the mushrooms on the night

steps.text: Grill the sausages until cooked through.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and plenty of the black pepper.
Reduce the shallot, stock, cream and the rest of the cracked pepper into a sauce.
Shred the mushrooms with a fork and fry in the oil with the paprika until crisp. Warm the pitas.
Fill the pitas with sausage, mushrooms, slaw and sauce and wrap tightly.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and rub the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; roast, char and finish on the night

steps.text: Cut 2 thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower and rub with 2 tbsp of the oil and salt. Toss the potatoes in the rest of the oil.
Roast the potatoes at 220C.
Roast the cauliflower steaks at 220C for 20 minutes, then grill over high heat to char.
Bake the onion rings.
Melt the butter with the garlic. Drizzle the lettuce wedges with ranch.
Pour the garlic butter over the cauliflower and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the sweet potato in the oil.
Soften the onions and garlic.
Add the chipotle, cumin, tomatoes, kidney beans, black beans, stock and sweet potato.
Cover and braise at 160C for 1 hour.
Bake the cornbread as the packet says and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the tarragon butter up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; spread it on the pumpkin and roast on the day

steps.text: Mix the soft butter with chopped tarragon and lemon zest. Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds, score the flesh and spread with the butter.
Roast at 200C for 60 minutes with the potatoes in chunks around it, crumbling the goat's cheese over the pumpkin for the last 5 minutes.
Steam the green beans and toss in the pan juices with a squeeze of the lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes and carrots up to 1 day ahead and keep in cold water in the fridge, drained well before roasting; rub the cauliflowers on the night

steps.text: Rub the cauliflowers with lemon, thyme, oil and salt and set in a large roasting tray with the potatoes and carrots.
Roast at 200C until the cauliflowers are golden and tender right through.
Rest the cauliflowers on a board.
Make gravy in the tray with the flour, juices, stock and soy sauce.
Cut the cauliflowers into wedges and serve at a big farmhouse table.

veg.n: Augustus Gloop's vegetarian bratwurst and pretzels
veg.make_ahead: The apple sauerkraut keeps up to 2 days in the fridge; rewarm it, then grill the sausages and warm the pretzels on the night

steps.text: Simmer the sauerkraut with the grated apple, apple juice and caraway.
Grill the vegetarian sausages over medium heat, turning, until browned all over.
Warm the pretzels at 180C.
Serve together with plenty of wholegrain mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can marinate up to 4 hours

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into cubes and toss in the teriyaki sauce, ginger and garlic.
Marinate.
Thread onto skewers.
Brush with the oil and grill, turning and basting with the leftover marinade.
Steam the rice.
Serve with sesame seeds.

veg.n: Foil baked stuffed eggplant with potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Stuff and wrap the eggplants up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; cook the eggplants and boil the potatoes on the night

steps.text: Cut a deep slit along each eggplant and stuff with lemon slices, dill, the butter for the eggplant and crumbled fetta, then season with salt and pepper.
Wrap in foil brushed with the olive oil.
Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 35 minutes until soft.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Toss the potatoes in the butter for the potatoes and the parsley.
Serve the eggplant in its foil.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the tofu in the lime, chilli and soy up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; wrap, cook the rice and grill fresh

steps.text: Soften the banana leaves in hot water. Cut the tofu into 4 slabs and rub with lime juice, chopped red chillies, soy sauce and salt.
Wrap each slab in a leaf.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.
Grill the parcels.
Serve the tofu in its leaf on the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in 2 tbsp of the oil in a hot heavy pot.
Cook the onions slowly in the rest of the oil for 20 minutes, then stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste.
Add the stock and potatoes, return the mushrooms, cover and simmer for 40 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom and chickpea stew up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; reheat and cook the dumplings on top on the night

steps.text: Dice the carrots, celery and onion and slice the mushrooms.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil, then add the vegetables, stock and chickpeas and simmer.
Stir the cream through.
Rub the butter into the flour, then mix in the parsley and milk.
Drop spoonfuls on top, cover and cook.

veg.make_ahead: Toss the mushrooms with the paprika and grate the cheeses up to 1 day ahead, chilled; prove, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Oil a deep tray and press the dough in.
Cover and prove until puffy.
Toss the mushrooms with the smoked paprika.
Spread with sauce and pile on the mozzarella, provolone, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, cheddar and mushrooms.
Bake at 220C until molten and golden.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; bake from cold and add 10 minutes

steps.text: Slice the sausages and brown in the oil with the fennel seeds.
Add garlic, passata and chilli flakes and simmer.
Boil the penne or ziti for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Toss with the sauce, spread in a baking dish and dot with ricotta.
Top with mozzarella and vegetarian parmesan-style cheese and bake at 200C.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflower with the butter, thyme and salt up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast on the day

steps.text: Rub the cauliflower with the butter, thyme leaves and salt.
Roast at 200C, covered with foil.
Uncover, add the potatoes and carrots tossed in the oil to the tray and keep roasting.
Rest the cauliflower, then cut into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Soften the onion, ginger and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Add the garam masala, tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer.
Fry the paneer in the rest of the oil in a separate pan until golden.
Cook the rice.
Stir the cream and paneer into the curry and serve with rice and warm naan.

veg.make_ahead: Spice and fry the tofu up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge; warm it in a pan and build the sandwiches to serve

ingredients.item: jar yellow mustard, on the side
slices rye bread, on the side

steps.text: Toss the smoked tofu with the pepper, coriander and paprika.
Fry in the oil until the edges crisp.
Spread the white bread with mayonnaise.
Add lettuce and tomato and pile the tofu high.
Put rye and mustard on the side for anyone who wants it.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onions, carrots, celery and tomato paste and cook.
Add the stock, cover and simmer.
Add the potatoes and butter beans and simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
Serve with Italian bread.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer and shred the jackfruit up to 2 days ahead, chilled in its liquid; crisp in a hot pan and serve

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (560g), drained

steps.text: Cut the hard cores off the jackfruit and rub with the cumin, oregano and salt.
Simmer, covered, with the orange juice, crushed garlic and stock for 30 minutes.
Shred the jackfruit with two forks.
Crisp in a hot pan with the oil.
Serve in tortillas with diced onion, coriander and lime.

veg.n: Grandma's glazed lentil loaf with mash
veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil mix and press it into the tin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; glaze, bake and make the mash on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry.
Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk. Mash half the lentils and mix with the rest, the mushroom mix, breadcrumbs, egg, soy sauce and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, then rest.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the peas and toss with the remaining butter. Slice the loaf and serve with mash and peas.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce.
Smash the balls flat on a smoking griddle, season with the salt and cook, then flip, add cheese and cook a minute more.
Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with pickles and sauce, then wrap in paper.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the onions and peel the potatoes up to 1 day ahead, onions chilled and potatoes in cold water. Cook everything on the night; the gravy reheats well

steps.text: Slice the onions and peel the potatoes.
Brown the sausages slowly in the oil in a pan.
Cook the onions in the same pan until soft.
Add the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Cook the peas.
Serve the sausages on the mash with peas and plenty of gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into big cubes, toss in the cornflour and fry in 3 tbsp of the oil until golden. Set aside.
Fry the garlic, ginger and red chillies in the rest of the oil. Add the tomato sauce, sweet chilli, soy and water.
Return the tofu and simmer until coated.
Stir in the beaten eggs until just set. Serve with the baguette to mop up the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thinly.
Slice the onions and capsicum.
Fry the onion and capsicum on a hot plate in 1 tbsp of the oil until soft.
Add the mushrooms with the rest of the oil and sear fast until browned.
Lay the provolone on top to melt and pile into the rolls.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the carrots and leeks and halve the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Add the barley, vegetables, rosemary and stock and simmer until the barley is tender.
Stir in the cannellini beans and warm through.
Serve in deep bowls with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Soup up to 3 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the pumpkin, carrots, garlic and thyme in oil until soft.
Blend with the hot vegetable stock until smooth.
Pour into bowls.
Pipe circles of sour cream on top and drag a skewer from the centre outwards to make a spiderweb.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the ginger. Pat the tofu dry and cut into thick slabs.
Brown the tofu in most of the oil.
Add the soy sauce, water, ginger, star anise, sugar and shiitake mushrooms.
Braise until glossy, turning the tofu once.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Stir-fry the bok choy with garlic in the rest of the oil.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the yoghurt, crushed garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground turmeric and lemon juice and coat the paneer and capsicum.
Marinate in the fridge for 2 hours.
Thread onto the skewers and grill hot until charred.
Cook the basmati with the saffron.
Serve with garlic sauce and pickled turnips.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled on a tray; top and bake on the night, with the chips going in at the same time

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthways into 8 thick slices.
Crumb in the flour, the eggs and the breadcrumbs and pan-fry in the oil until golden.
Top with the passata, the smoked tofu and the grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.
Bake the chips at 220C while the parmigiana cooks, then serve with salad.

veg.n: Mr Wilson's rosemary haloumi with mint sauce
veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Toss the haloumi with the rosemary, garlic and oil.
Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Grill the haloumi 2 minutes a side until charred. Cook the peas.
Serve everything with a spoon of mint sauce, in peace, with no interruptions at all.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the onion and chilli powder.
Add the tomatoes and kidney beans.
Simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls topped with sour cream and cheddar.

veg.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Cook the onions in the butter over low heat until jammy.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, season, sear hard on both sides until tender, then slice thickly.
Split and toast the ciabatta, spread with horseradish cream and pile with mushrooms, onions and rocket.

veg.n: Big Chris's mushroom and ale pie and chips
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, plus 2 tbsp for the mushrooms

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in 2 tbsp of the oil with the sliced onions and thyme.
Add the ale, lentils and soy sauce and simmer for 30 minutes.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a dish, cover with puff pastry and bake at 200C.
Cut the potatoes into thick chips and fry twice in the rest of the oil until golden.
Cook the peas and crush with the butter and mint.

veg_af.n: Big Chris's mushroom pie and chips (alcohol free)

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, plus 2 tbsp for the mushrooms

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in 2 tbsp of the oil with the sliced onions and thyme.
Add the vegetable stock, malt vinegar, lentils and soy sauce and simmer for 30 minutes.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a dish, cover with puff pastry and bake at 200C.
Cut the potatoes into thick chips and fry twice in the rest of the oil until golden.
Cook the peas and crush with the butter and mint.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the onion up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; simmer and griddle the sausages just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the vegetarian sausages, then griddle until blistered.
Warm the sauerkraut in a small pan.
Steam the buns and chop the onion.
Fill the buns with sausages, mustard, onion, relish and sauerkraut.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, better the next day

steps.text: Dice the onions, carrots and potatoes and halve the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then soften the onion and carrot.
Add the potatoes, stock, thyme and chickpeas, cover and simmer 40 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Serve with slices of the Italian loaf.

veg.make_ahead: Salsa up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Tear the mushrooms into strips and marinate in the oil, lime juice, three of the garlic cloves and the cumin for 30 minutes.
Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with the tomato and remaining garlic for a salsa roja.
Sear the mushrooms on a very hot grill until charred at the edges.
Warm the tortillas and serve with the mushrooms, salsa, onion and coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Press and slice the tofu and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead, chilled; stir-fry on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and slice, shred the cabbage and slice the spring onions.
Stir-fry the tofu in a smoking wok with most of the vegetable oil until browned.
Add the cabbage, bean sprouts and noodles and toss with the mushroom oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil.
Scramble the eggs in a second pan with the rest of the oil, add the rice and spring onion and fry until hot, then serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Slice and oil the haloumi up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill just before serving and dress the mango at the last minute

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into 8 thick slices and brush with the oil.
Grill over high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Toss the shredded green mango with the mint, the sliced chilli, the juice of the limes and the soy sauce and pile on top.
